::: {.callout-important}
### Setting up Classroom 50 (do this once, in order)

1. **Accept the GitHub organization invitation** emailed to you by Classroom 50 (check your spam folder). You must do this before anything else will work.
2. **[Link your NetID on Classroom 50](https://classroom50.org/gph-2182/gph-gu-2182-fall-2026/onboard)**, which connects your GitHub account to your name in the gradebook.
3. **Then** open the Weekly Exercise 1 link above to accept the assignment.

If your invitation expired or never arrived, email the instructor and a new one will be sent.
:::

::: {.callout-tip}
### Git and GitHub setup, written out

Everything we did in class is documented step by step in the
[setup guides](../guides/index.qmd): [installing the software](../guides/install.qmd),
[connecting RStudio to GitHub](../guides/github-setup.qmd),
